We have already taken steps to strengthen our entity signals, including: Consistent business name across our website and profiles Consistent NAP information Google Business Profile Organization/LocalBusiness structured data WebSite and WebPage schema Official social profiles in sameAs Third-party business/review profiles Clear company/about information on our website Explicit clarification on our website that we are not affiliated with similarly named publishers Despite this, Google’s AI Overview is still occasionally conflating the two entities. Should we avoid mentioning the similarly named business entirely and instead focus on strengthening our own entity signals? Has anyone successfully resolved a similar AI Overview entity conflation issue? If so, what changes actually made a measurable difference? I’m specifically looking for an SEO/entity-level solution rather than simply changing the wording of the website, because the main concern is getting Google to consistently understand that these are two distinct entities.
